root_cause.text: The `gem_get_ethtool_stats` function in the MACB network driver calculates the statistics buffer size using the hardcoded maximum queue limit (`MACB_MAX_QUEUES`) rather than the actual number of active queues (`bp->num_queues`), causing an out-of-bounds write when the device has fewer queues configured than the maximum supported.
